Senses.Explanation: The hinge of a stock exchange: the sentence leans on the tree like a vine, and the question always follows — when the tree falls and the vine withers, where does the sentence go? The answers refuse to fall with it: loud laughter, a slap on the sound, cassia cut from the moon. The Song hinge: Yuanwu Keqin opens a hall address with it — with-sentence and without-sentence overstep lineage and rule, like a vine leaning on a tree, a silver mountain and an iron wall; when the tree falls and the vine withers, how many lose their nostrils, and even those who gather it back up are already a thousand, ten thousand miles out; Dahui Zonggao sets it and prices it — the green-eyed barbarian does not know where it falls; where does it fall? He snaps up the staff, calls the assembly to look, it is coming straight down, eyes sharp, and throws the staff down; Wansong Xingxiu raises the case whole in his comment record — Shushan crosses four thousand li with his cloth roll to ask it, Guishan laughs loudly, and when Shushan protests being toyed with, Guishan calls his attendant to fetch cash. Later answers to the fall: Hanyue Fazang answers the ask with wind and moon year after year while the human heart changes, and the monk bows to the ground — now one knows propriety; Yushan Shangsi takes the ask through the pair, calls the vine-tree the model of old and new, and rules the tree-fall answer one that turns along the speaker's vein, no workman; Yulin Tongxiu at late assembly answers that it is drawn well and painted fine, and at the tree-fall question strikes along with the very sound; the monk before Tian'an Sheng raises the old story of Shushan's ask and Guishan's laugh, and the master answers that the laugh could not be held back; Tianyin Yuanxiu raises the other wing — Shishuang taking leave of Guishan, asked his understanding of the couplet and giving no answer — rules it true, and follows him on to Daowu; Feiyin Tongrong cites Guishan's own version, the mangy horse tied to a withered stump blocking the road the whole year, and at the tree-fall bids one cut the cassia in the moon so the clear light will only be more; Baichi Xingyuan verses the mud-pan version — the face twisted round and former feeling severed, leaving that one nowhere to hide.
